thread:
mara: Heads up — saw cross-tenant rows in insights for a canary user
alex: when did this start? repro steps?
mara: quick repro: quickswitch to workspace A then open insights for a user in B, some rows show orgid from previous session. screenshot: https://img.redwood/example.png
samira: saw similar in staging earlier today, flagged it around 09:12
alex: which commit touched console-adapter middleware? last deploy was yesterday afternoon
jin: deploy-bot: deployment console-adapter v1.3.4 finished at 2024-11-02T15:40Z (canary)
alex: suspect header sticky in adapter; we changed header merging logic for internal API routing last week
alex: minimal repro and suspected stack below
alex: ```
// console internal-adapter middleware
req.headers['x-tenant'] = req.headers['x-tenant'] || ctx.tenant
proxyReq.setHeader('x-tenant', req.headers['x-tenant'])
```
alex: problem: when incoming req has no x-tenant we fallback to ctx.tenant, but ctx is coming from a previous request on a long-lived adapter instance -> reuse of tenant value
samira: ah, so shared instance state. adapter instances are reused by the proxy pool
tess: can we compute header from request-scoped auth only? removing fallback to ctx seems safer
mara: I opened PR draft with suggested change (adapter/tenant-fix) and a unit test that simulates concurrent requests
alex: adding tests. Also will change middleware to not mutate req.headers in place
samira: also think we should add a telemetry counter for adapter.instance_tenant to detect sticky state early
jin: deploy-bot: rolling back canary for console-adapter v1.3.4 — rollback started
alex: thanks — rolling back buys us time. I'll push hotfix branch adapter/fix-tenant-sticky and run staging integration
tess: quick audit idea: check prefetch/kv cache keys. If prefetch keys omit tenant id we could be serving cached rows across tenants
alex: checked prefetch layer: keys are currently `prefetch:${route}` (no tenant suffix) — big oops
alex: plan: change to `prefetch:${tenant}:${route}` and migrate gracefully (TTL + safe invalidation)
mara: also add an alert: cross_tenant_rows > 0 for any production insight query should page SRE on-call
samira: agreed — add dashboard panel and an eval rule tied to our regression tests so this doesn't slip again
jin: noted — will schedule canary validation to include cross-tenant check in rollout job
devops-bot: @deploy-bot scheduled a canary holdpoint for console-adapter after integration tests
alex: timeline: rollback done. I'll make the header change + cache key change, add unit + integration tests, run staging validation. Target merge + canary redeploy by EOD.
mara: please tag me on the PR and paste pipeline output to this thread once staging passes
samira: adding incident-channel note with repro steps and attach logs
tess: small follow-up: let's also add a lint rule that forbids storing tenant into module-level variables in adapter codebase
alex: good call. I'll add that to the PR and add one-off grep check to CI
mara: thanks everyone. big props for quick rollback :thumbsup:
samira: :raised_hands:
